title: A Dish of Orts : Chiefly Papers on the Imagination, and on Shakespeare

Through his discussion of various themes, including the creative process and the nature of true greatness, MacDonald sets the stage for a more profound inquiry into how the imagination shapes art, literature, and personal growth.
